__2 Unanimity. 
__3 Identity, sameness. 
__4 Especially, the identity of the human soul or of the universe with the Deity. 
__5 An aggregate, whole. 
__6 (In alg.) The product of the length and depth of the portions or little excavations differing in depth (Colebrooke).
